description: Defines classes and functions for handling IP addresses and IP prefixes within the quiche networking library, including address normalization, string conversion, and subnet comparison.

classes.name: QuicheIpAddress
classes.description: Represents an IP address, supporting IPv4 and IPv6, with methods for normalization, string conversion, and subnet comparison.

classes.name: QuicheIpPrefix
classes.description: Represents an IP prefix consisting of an IP address and a prefix length.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::IsInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the IP address object is initialized.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::address_family
methods.description: Returns the address family (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::AddressFamilyToInt
methods.description: Returns the address family as an integer.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::ToPackedString
methods.description: Returns the address as a byte sequence in network byte order.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the IP address.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::Normalized
methods.description: Returns a normalized version of the address, converting mapped IPv4 addresses to pure IPv4.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::DualStacked
methods.description: Returns an address suitable for IPv6-aware contexts, converting IPv4 addresses to IPv4-mapped addresses.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::FromPackedString
methods.description: Initializes the address from a byte sequence.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::FromString
methods.description: Initializes the address from a string.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::IsIPv4
methods.description: Checks if the address is IPv4.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::IsIPv6
methods.description: Checks if the address is IPv6.

methods.name: QuicheIpAddress::InSameSubnet
methods.description: Checks if another address is in the same subnet.

methods.name: QuicheIpPrefix::ToString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string of the IP prefix.
